svg.text: THE ESTATE, THE HOUSE TRAIL: the new way from the Lake to the Haunted House (a proposal)
north is up · one plot = 12 x 12 squares = 42 m
to The Estate (the Lake's West Bank)
to the Haunted House (by the Treehouse)
to the Haunted House (the Graveyard's back gate)
the hill's open top · a board fits
the gatehouse yard · a board fits
dead woods and brush (the wall of the place)
open ground (a clearing, a field, a yard)
- - a FOUND way up (a climb, a trunk, a ladder)
┄ level ON PURPOSE (an open place, a fight place)
Every box is one 3.5 m battle square. The number in a square is its LEVEL (1 level = 1.75 m); lighter = higher. A black triangle = a RAMP square, pointing uphill (one level over two squares).
A WHITE BAR with a tooth = a LEDGE: you hop DOWN across it (the tooth points down) and cannot climb back. That is how the walk works today: no new rule.
Plot lines by district: T = The House Trail. Dashes = a new plot. Orange dots = the ways out of the room; their squares keep today's height. A PROPOSAL: nothing is built from it until mondo says so.
